messages:
release-bot: Weekly release-train note — heads up for the upcoming v4.1.0 rollout. Soft freeze for feature merges starts 2025-03-12 22:00 UTC. Exceptions allowed for P0/P1 fixes and approved infra patches. Please follow the new incremental promotion policy below.

nina: Incremental promotion policy = default canary 15% for 2h, promote to 50% for 4h if metrics stable, then full ramp if still green. This replaces the old 10%/25% split.

devon: Changelog highlights: improved batching heuristic, reduced memory on tokenizer init, and a small fix for kv-cache eviction. No schema changes in this release.

ops-oncall: Exemptions: open a short ticket, add label `freeze-exempt`, ping @ops-oncall and @release-bot with rollback notes. Approvals required: SRE lead + release manager. Use `/exempt PR-#### --reason "brief"` to request.

caleb: Canary monitoring hooks updated: require `user_err_rate` and `init_latency`. Auto-rollback will trigger if user_err_rate increases >3% within a 30m window.

nina: Canaries scheduled in us-west-2 and eu-central for tomorrow noon UTC. I'll post dashboard links when they start.

devon: Reminder for Dedicated deploys: run the prewarm script for any model >1GB and attach logs. See internal ops doc.

release-bot: Final: docs-only changes are exempt but avoid config/schema edits. Follow the checklist in the release calendar and report any exemptions by 2025-03-12 18:00 UTC. Follow-up summary posted 2025-03-13 09:00 UTC.
